repos.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
repos.intro: Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools.
repos.description_zh: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE)。用於 bare metal 上 GPU Kubernetes 的管理平面 (management plane)。
repos.intro_zh: 在您自己的 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施上執行託管式 Kubernetes 服務。NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) 提供管理平面，讓平台團隊可以透過安裝它來為客戶建立並營運 Kubernetes 叢集。每個工作負載叢集 (workload cluster) 都有其獨立的 Kubernetes 控制平面 (control plane)、etcd 與節點池 (node pools)。
repos.description_src: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.

repos.intro: Context-compression plugin — billion-context is all you need.
features: compress — fold a message range into a detailed summary.
decompress — restore a compressed range when exact details are needed again.
search_context — keyword search over compressed summaries and visible messages.
acp_status — context-usage overview plus which ranges are still compressible.

search_context — 在壓縮後的摘要與可見訊息中進行關鍵字搜尋。
acp_status — context 使用量概覽，以及哪些範圍仍可進行壓縮。
